verdict.rationale: The docs show CockroachDB offers changefeeds, an event-streaming (CDC) mechanism with at-least-once delivery and ordering guarantees, so users can subscribe to data-change events. No evidence shows those events are delivered to a webhook/HTTP endpoint. A community comment says CDC was enterprise-locked, and an older 2017 comment noting no change-notification mechanism predates changefeeds. missing for 10: explicit webhook sink/endpoint delivery documentation, configuration details for webhook subscriptions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
